optimizedDescription.value: Canonical spec ID: workspace:capabilityPath; bare path → default workspace; reject unknown workspace.

optimizedContext.value:
# Spec ID Format

## Rules
- Format: `workspace:capabilityPath` (colon sep; all `/` in path). Single format everywhere.
- No colon → workspace `default`, whole string = capability path.
- Unknown workspace (colon-qualified) → reject.
- Parse: first `:` → workspace + path (validate workspace); else default + full string. Never slash-as-workspace.
- Normalize bare → fully-qualified at boundary. `specDependsOn` MUST use fully-qualified IDs.

## Constraints
- Workspace: no `/` or `:`. Capability path: no `:`. Separator always `:`.
